recognize_zh: 中型淋巴球具有豐富淡藍色細胞質，細胞核明顯分成兩葉（bilobed/binucleated lymphocyte），染色質成熟、無明顯核仁；在女性持續淋巴球增多的背景下，應聯想到持續性多株 B 細胞淋巴球增多症（PPBL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a deeply cleft, bilobed (binucleate-appearing) nucleus
Mature, moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant, pale basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular border
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable; no smudge cells or blasts in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus composed of two closely apposed lobes, mature chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a generous rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. A normal segmented neutrophil and unremarkable red cells and platelets are present in the field. Binucleated lymphocytes of this type, in a patient with stable polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis and polyclonal IgM elevation, are suggestive of persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis; confirmation requires flow cytometry showing polyclonal (kappa and lambda) B cells.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+ with light-chain restriction rather than polyclonal.
Villous lymphocytes show polar cytoplasmic projections, not bilobed nuclei, and are monotypic by flow cytometry.
Flower cells have multilobated, hyperchromatic nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD4+ T cells, whereas PPBL cells are polyclonal B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are large with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and are transient, whereas PPBL shows persistent binucleated B cells with raised polyclonal IgM.
